$comment: O5.5.2 acceptance: every audio cue has a visual cue listed in a data table. Sounds from O5.3.2 and amendment MB-6 to MB-19; visual twins from O5.5.2 (play clock pulse) and I9.1.2 (event cue marks). switch = the setting that turns the sound off; field-cue switches of MB-17 not yet in the schema are requested from the integrator (CR-G98-1) and listed under pendingSwitch.

cues.sound: Referee's whistle at the dead ball
cues.visual: Whistle mark at the dead-ball spot (I9.1.2)
Ball marker leaves the line and the play clock clears

cues.sound: Tick each second under 10 s on the play clock
cues.visual: Play clock pulses each second under 10 s
Alert badge and banner in the top bar (O1.4)

cues.sound: Crowd bed at the play's noise level
cues.visual: Noise meter on the game frame
Flash at the fumble or ring at the interception, and the result line
Cross at the tackle and the result line

cues.sound: Crowd reaction: flag against the home team
cues.visual: Yellow flag marker at the foul spot
Contact bar weight at the contact
Announcement text in the result line (I7.1.2)
